title: Fertility: Simpler Villager Needs
description: A simple data pack to reduce the type of foods villagers need from you in my modpack Fertility.
body:
If [Fertility Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fertility) is too challenging or you want a simpler progression path, this data pack is for you. It reduces villager needs to just a few recipes, so you can quickly set up your automation to cook away!

This data pack is meant for the [Fertility Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fertility) and will not do anything outside that modpack.
